contexts.text: Man's proprium... appears bony... AC 149:2.
Bones = those things which are lower, because having the least vitality.
Bones in the Word = the proprium, in fact the proprium vivified by the Lord. Illustrated.
The Lord's proprium is signified by... a Spirit hath not flesh and bones as ye see Me have.
Bone of bones () = the proprium of the outward man; bone = the proprium not so much vivified... AC 157.
They become at last as it were bony...
To spread out the bones () = the infernal things with such.
With those who have been deceitful and hypocrites (the memory) appears as it were bony, and of ebony.
The vivified bones (). TCR 594.
My bone and my flesh () = conjunction (as to truths and as to goods). Explained. Bone = the intellectual proprium... thus the proprium as to truth.
Hence bones in the Word = truth, and in the opposite sense, falsity. Fully illustrated.
Truth supports good as bones do the flesh. AC 9634:2.
A smell as of burnt horn or bone. AC 5573. SE 3206. SE 3498.
On the correspondence of the bones. General article. SE 920. SE 5141.
The Societies of Spirits to which the cartilages and bones correspond are very numerous. They are such as have very little spiritual life...

Other Spirits speak through those who relate to the bones, they themselves knowing little of what they say, but still they talk, placing all their delight in it. To such a state are those reduced who have led an evil life, and yet have some remains of good stored up in them...
They who emerge from vastations, and serve for such uses as the bones do, have no determinate thought... SE 920.
When falsity... is confirmed by many things, a hardness appears like the hardness of bone.
The hard things with man, as the teeth, bones, cartilages, correspond to truths and goods of the lowest Natural.
A bony donkey () = lowest service. Bone = what has little spiritual life in it. AE 445:4.

Ye shall cause my bones to go up from here () = that there shall be a representative of the Church... Joseph's bones = that which is the most external, or the ultimate of the Church, thus its representative... AC 8101.
(Correspondence of ossification.)

Ye shall not break a bone in it () = that scientific truth shall be entire. A bone = the ultimate in which the interior things are terminated as in their base, that they may be supported in such a manner as to prevent spreading out. Such an ultimate in spiritual things is the Scientific... Scientifics are as the bones in man; if they are not entire, or in their own order, as when out of joint, or distorted, the form of the body is varied, and the actions according thereto.

To break the bones () = to destroy the truths from the Divine which are last in order, on which rest and by which are supported interior truths and goods, and which if destroyed cause the whole superstructure to fall. Ultimate truths are those of the letter of the Word... on which the interior truths rest... That bones = truths, References.
Bones () = scientific truths.
The bones which were ruddy () = scientific truths which are ultimate, and serve the rest.
Under Base, see this reference.
(The use of the bones below the neck.)
The bones of kings and princes drawn out of the graves () = truths profaned; the bones of priests and prophets = goods profaned.
The thigh, shoulder, and choice of the bones () = Divine truths from Divine good in successive order.
After this tearing to pieces (profaners) scarcely appear as men, but as burnt bones...
Such (as are merely external) appear as it were bony without life as to the head and face...
The interiors of those who have confirmed themselves against the Divine... are ossified.
With many of the infernals no face appears, but in place of it something hairy, or bony.
Until (the fibres) become cartilages and bones.
(Profaners) no longer appear as men, but as bones with some skin drawn over them.
(The heathen) constitute those things which are called the skins, membranes, cartilages, and bones.
In place of feet ankles of bone without flesh.
(Violators) appear as consisting of bones with only some skin drawn over.
(Origin of the bones of the skull by the induration of the membranes.) SE 3913.
(On those who can only be amended so as to become scarcely self conscious, as the bones are, in which however there is some life.) SE 3912. SE 3944.
Those correspond to the bones who have studied various sciences and have made no use of them...
The celestial correspond to... the flesh, even to the tendinous parts, the cartilaginous and bony ones.

My bone was not hid from Thee when I was made in secret () = that no falsity which was made was hidden... Bone = truth in the ultimate of order, and in the opposite sense, falsity. References. AE 196:end.
Bones () = ultimates.
Bones () = truths in their own ultimate, thus truths in the whole complex.
Dry bones () = those in whom there is nothing of spiritual life. AE 419:3.
Flesh and bones () = man's ultimates.
Bone () = truth before it is vivified, that is, conjoined with good, as is truth of the memory.
His bones () = the truths of the ultimate.
A man's bone () = infernal falsity.
The bones () = truths in the ultimate of order upon which spiritual truths are founded; but dry bones = falsities from evil.
Bones () = falsities and evils.
The Church is compared to dry bones (), because they have no good of love and truth of doctrine. AE 666:3.
